steps.sql: DECLARE @j json; SELECT 7 AS before_value; SET @j.modify('$.a',1); SELECT 9 AS after_value;

DECLARE @j json; BEGIN TRY SET @j.modify('$.a',1); END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT ERROR_NUMBER() AS number,ERROR_STATE() AS state,ERROR_MESSAGE() AS message; END CATCH; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"a":1}',@p nvarchar(30)=NULL; SET @j.modify(@p,2); SELECT @j AS j,@@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;

DECLARE @j json; SELECT 7 AS before_value; SET @j.modify('$.a');
DECLARE @j json; SELECT 7 AS before_value; SET @j.modify(1,2);
